description: Values shared verbatim between the Python engine (orchestrator/contract.py) and the HT bridge (bridge/extensions/orchestrator/*.ts, via the symlinked copy of this file). This is the on-disk layout and CLI wire contract: stream file names, protected file names, the durable-write CLI's exit codes and body statuses, batch/id limits, the path-redaction regexes and the state-root environment variables/default. It does NOT hold orchestration method vocabulary (capabilities, tiers, effort, roles) — that lives in method.json. Editing this file edits the on-disk contract for both runtimes at once; keep both sides' behaviour identical except where a field is explicitly documented as intentionally different (see redaction_regex).

redaction_regex._todo: these already differ in behaviour (python's character class excludes only space/tab/newline/pipe; ts's excludes any whitespace plus pipe) and are stored separately on purpose. DO NOT harmonize them here — that is a deliberate follow-up decision, not part of this refactor. Each side must keep importing exactly its own key.
